description: A unified notification plugin for Jellyfin that sends notifications to multiple systems.
name: Multify
overview: Sends notifications to Telegram, Gotify, ntfy, and generic webhooks with configurable event filtering, user filtering, library filtering, and customizable templates.

versions.changelog:
- Hot-reload plugin configuration without server restart: `MultifySender` now reads `MultifyPlugin.Instance.Configuration` per call (like `jellyfin-plugin-webhook` `WebhookSender`) instead of injected stale instance; `LibraryEventHostedService` (Singleton) now resolves `IWebhookSender`/`DashboardAlert` via `IServiceProvider.CreateScope()` per `ItemAdded`/`ItemDeleted` queue item, so `OnlySelected`/`AllExcept` changes apply instantly after UI Save (validated: `Thunderbolts*` private movie sent to Telegram id 3696 and Ntfy without restart after 15:48 save)
- `{{LibraryName}}` now correctly shows CollectionFolder (`Private - Filmes` `04f64be…`) instead of physical Folder (`movies` `a186…`) via `CorrectLibraryInfo()` path-prefix against `ILibraryManager.GetVirtualFolders()` (validated on generic webhookd `catchal`l for `Jurassic World Rebirth` and `Thunderbolts*`)
- `MdbList` quota burn: per-key `SemaphoreSlim` single-flight + 1h negative cache for 404 in `MdbListService` prevents thundering herd on 1Hz `PlaybackProgress` and re-query of invalid ids
- `GetMediaType` exact lower switch with Contains fallback for custom subclass names
- `DeepCopyDict` deep-copies nested `IDictionary`/`IList`, downgraded `DEBUG-ENRICH` to `LogDebug`
- `TelegramMessageStore`: per-key `SemaphoreSlim` (`GetKeyLock`) makes `Get→Edit/Send→Store` atomic, preventing duplicate messages; `TelegramClient` holds per-key lock for edit path

- Bump version to `0.0.9` / `0.0.9.0` (`build.yaml`, `Directory.Build.props`)

- `REPORT.md` (catalog sanitizer report, no longer needed after 4-part version fix in `v0.0.8`)

- MDBList now queried only when a matched destination template actually references an MDBList variable (MdblistScore/ImdbRating/etc.) or SendAllProperties is set — prevents 1Hz PlaybackProgress hot-loop burning daily quota (4012 calls, 3016× 429 in log_20260908)
- Library Filter `OnlySelected` blocking: normalize GUIDs (N vs D, case-insensitive) for LibraryId/UserId and resolve CollectionFolder vs physical Folder alias via VirtualFolders path prefix (AF92 Filmes vs F7E7 movies)
- Test notification fallback now respects LibraryFilter — sets LibraryId/LibraryName/Path to the filter's VirtualFolder instead of `N/A`, so "Test" with a filter is actually sent
- ItemDeleted never sent: HandleItemRemoved now uses `e.Item` directly (upstream webhook `ItemDeletedHandler` pattern) and skips virtual items — `GetItemById` after removal always returned null
- Packaging: normalize version to 4-part (0.0.8 -> 0.0.8.0) and validate version matches sourceUrl tag per catalog REPORT.md — prevents 0.0.6.0 vs v0.0.7 mismatch

- MultifySender reuses matched destination lists for MDBList guard and send phase to avoid double LINQ enumeration
- FilterService now optionally injects ILibraryManager for path-based library resolution
- REPORT.md added with catalog sanitizer analysis

- Telegram edit-on-duplicate: when the same item (matched by TmdbId) is notified again, the existing Telegram message is edited instead of sending a new one.
- Ignore Trailer items from all notification types.

- Defer ItemAdded/ItemUpdated notifications via an internal queue until remote metadata is available, so messages are no longer sent before Jellyfin populates details.

- Readiness check now requires a real content field (Overview, Genres, OfficialRating, or CommunityRating) in addition to a provider ID, preventing "(Unknown)"/"N/A" placeholders in sent messages.
- Map MDBList "tomatoes" source to RottenTomatoesRating so Rotten Tomatoes ratings populate correctly.

- Removed manifest.json from the main branch.

- Revised README for installation and message customization.

- `SubtitleDownloadFailureNotifier` — new Subtitle Download Failure notification type
- Playback data template variables (play method, position, volume, playback bitrate) via shared `PlaybackBitrateService`
- Stream info and metadata variables (VideoCodec, AudioCodec, VideoResolution, VideoRange, Framerate, AudioChannels, SubtitleLanguages, Width/Height, PlayCount, IsFavorite, Played)
- People variables (Director, Writers, CastList, CastJson)
- Parent poster URLs: SeasonPoster, SeriesPoster, TmdbSeasonPosterUrl, TmdbSeriesPosterUrl
- TMDB image URL enrichment via `IProviderManager` (replaces custom TmdbService), including test-notification flow
- `PhotoUrlTemplate` options for Gotify and ntfy destinations
- Select All / Select None buttons on Item Type checkboxes
- Real library items used for test notifications with realistic fallback
- `UserDataService` for per-user PlayCount/IsFavorite/Played/UserRating
- Version bump to 0.0.6

- MDBList authentication: `?apikey=` query param instead of Bearer header; null score handling
- `FormatResolution` bug for non-16:9 aspect ratios
- MarkdownV2 escaping: URLs skipped from escaping, un-escaped after template substitution, escaped values preserve formatting markers
- Telegram: return API error description instead of generic 400; message editing only for ItemAdded/ItemUpdated
- `UserFilter`/`LibraryFilter` changed from `Guid[]` to `string[]` to fix JSON deserialization
- Generic webhook header/field pairing and malformed Content-Type handling
- ntfy URL join double-slash, priority clamp (1-5), header hardening (RFC 2047 encoding)
- `LibraryCache` sync dispose, timer leak, culture-aware `ToString` for JSON (invariant)
- Release workflow: manifest branch history preserved; changelog now extracted from the annotated tag message into both the Jellyfin manifest and GitHub release body
- `scripts/package.py`: numeric semver sort, prerelease sort order, Jellyfin 12.0 default target
- Numerous StyleCop/build errors and dead code removal across notifiers and services

- Target framework `net9.0` → `net10.0` for Jellyfin 12 compatibility
- Jellyfin NuGet packages to `12.*-*` with `targetAbi` 12.0.0.0
- Config UI to tabbed layout with section-based destination cards
- Jellyfin ImageUrl template variables renamed (dropped 'Url' suffix)
- Removed TVDB URLs, `OriginalLanguage`, and `HomePageUrl` template variables

- Unused workflow files (build.yaml, publish.yaml, publish-unstable.yaml)
